alt: Three cards named Rockstar, PlayStation and Xbox, each with a green tick and a red cross example, for checking status pages first.

data.title: Check these three pages first

cards.title: Rockstar
cards.body: Rockstar status page. Green tick: services up. Red cross: an outage is listed.

cards.title: PlayStation
cards.body: PlayStation status page. Check if store, accounts or games are marked down.

cards.title: Xbox
cards.body: Xbox status page. Check live services and store before you change settings.

data.note: The red cross is an example. Open the live status pages — do not go by this diagram alone.
